license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice, or attempt to offer to practice, medicine and surgery, or other areas of practice requiring a license, certificate or registration from the board, as such practice is defined in this act, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license, certificate or registration issued under this act.

umbrella_agency.value: Bureau of Professional and Occupational Affairs, Department of State
umbrella_agency.quote: "Commissioner."  The Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs in the Department of State.

moral_character_required.quote: the applicant is of legal age, is of good moral character and is not addicted to the intemperate use of alcohol or the habitual use of narcotics or other habit-forming drugs

degree_required.value: academic degree in medicine and surgery from a medical college
degree_required.quote: An individual is not qualified for a license to practice medicine and surgery unless the individual has received an academic degree in medicine and surgery from a medical college

accrediting_body.value: any accrediting body recognized by the board
accrediting_body.quote: An institution of higher learning which has been fully accredited, by any accrediting body recognized by the board, as an agency to provide courses in the art and science of medicine and surgery

degree_level.quote: An individual is not qualified for a license to practice medicine and surgery unless the individual has received an academic degree in medicine and surgery from a medical college

school_approval_basis.quote: fully accredited, by any accrediting body recognized by the board

credential_pegged.quote: An individual is not qualified for a license to practice medicine and surgery unless the individual has received an academic degree in medicine and surgery from a medical college

required.quote: No license without restriction may be issued to a graduate of an accredited medical college unless the applicant has completed successfully, as a resident, two years of approved graduate medical training.

experience_source.quote: No license without restriction may be issued to a graduate of an accredited medical college unless the applicant has completed successfully, as a resident, two years of approved graduate medical training.

duration.quote: the applicant has completed successfully, as a resident, two years of approved graduate medical training.

kind.quote: completed successfully, as a resident, two years of approved graduate medical training.

exams.name: Board examination for license without restriction
exams.notes: Board holds at least two examinations per year; second attempt allowed after six months and within two years; after two failures, applicant must complete one additional year of graduate medical training and apply de novo.
exams.quote: The board shall hold at least two examinations for applicants for a license without restriction each year. In case of failure at any such examination, the applicant shall have, after the expiration of six months and within two years, the privilege of a second examination by the board.

interval_years.quote: in no case shall such renewal period be longer than two years

available.quote: Reciprocity or endorsement may be established at the discretion of the board.

requirements.value: Reciprocity requires that the board and a licensing authority in another jurisdiction each recognize that their respective requirements are equivalent, and the applicant holds a similar license in the other jurisdiction. Endorsement allows issuance to an applicant who does not meet standard requirements but has achieved cumulative qualifications accepted as equivalent.
requirements.quote: the term "reciprocity" means the act of the board and a licensing authority in another jurisdiction, each recognizing that the requirements for a license or certificate in this Commonwealth and in the other jurisdiction are equivalent, issuing a license or certificate to an applicant who possesses a similar license or certificate in the other jurisdiction.

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice, or attempt to offer to practice, medicine and surgery, or other areas of practice requiring a license, certificate or registration from the board, as such practice is defined in this act, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license, certificate or registration issued under this act.

credential_type.quote: The board may grant the following licenses and certificates: (1) License without restriction.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice, or attempt to offer to practice, medicine and surgery, or other areas of practice requiring a license, certificate or registration from the board, as such practice is defined in this act, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license, certificate or registration issued under this act.

title_protection.quote: No person other than a medical doctor shall engage in any of the following conduct except as authorized or exempted in this act: ... Hold forth as authorized to practice medicine and surgery through use of a title, including, but not necessarily limited to, medical doctor, doctor of medicine, doctor of medicine and surgery, doctor of a designated disease, physician, physician of a designated disease, or any abbreviation for the foregoing.

scope_protection.quote: No person other than a medical doctor shall engage in any of the following conduct except as authorized or exempted in this act: (1) Practice medicine and surgery.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license, certification or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license, certification or registration contained in this act or regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representations in practice or in obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representations in the practice of the profession or practicing fraud or deceit, either alone or as a conspirator, in obtaining a license, certification or registration or in obtaining admission to a medical college.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a felony or a misdemeanor relating to a health profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of a felony or being convicted of a misdemeanor relating to a health profession or receiving probation without verdict, disposition in lieu of trial or an Accelerated Rehabilitative Disposition in the disposition of felony charges

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or other disciplinary action taken in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license or other authorization to practice the profession revoked or suspended or having other disciplinary action taken, or an application for a license or other authorization refused, revoked or suspended by a proper licensing authority of another state, territory, possession or country, or a branch of the Federal Government.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, addiction, felony conviction, or mental incompetency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice the profession with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, addiction to drugs or alcohol, having been convicted of a felonious act prohibited by the act of April 14, 1972 (P.L.233, No.64), known as The Controlled Substance, Drug, Device and Cosmetic Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful regulation or order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful regulation promulgated by the board or violating a lawful order of the board previously entered by the board in a disciplinary proceeding.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly maintaining association with or aiding an unlicensed person to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly maintaining a professional connection or association with any person who is in violation of this act or regulations of the board or knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring or advising any unlicensed person to practice a profession contrary to this act or regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct, including departure from ethical or quality standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct. Unprofessional conduct shall include departure from or failing to conform to an ethical or quality standard of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a manner that presents an immediate and clear danger to public health or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in such manner as to present an immediate and clear danger to public health or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting outside the scope of a license or certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting outside the scope of a license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or deceptive biennial registration with the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or deceptive biennial registration with the board.

definition_quote.value: The art and science of which the objectives are the cure of diseases and the preservation of the health of man, including the practice of the healing art with or without drugs, except healing by spiritual means or prayer.
definition_quote.quote: "Medicine and surgery."  The art and science of which the objectives are the cure of diseases and the preservation of the health of man, including the practice of the healing art with or without drugs, except healing by spiritual means or prayer.

methods_authorized.quote: the practice of the healing art with or without drugs, except healing by spiritual means or prayer.

drug_authority.value: Medical doctors may prescribe and dispense drugs as part of the practice of medicine and surgery; physician assistants may prescribe and dispense drugs only at the direction of a physician per board regulations.
drug_authority.quote: the practice of the healing art with or without drugs, except healing by spiritual means or prayer.

license_status_types.quote: The board may grant the following licenses and certificates: (1) License without restriction. (2) Interim limited license. (3) Graduate license. (4) Institutional license. (5) Temporary license. (6) Extraterritorial license.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Graduates of unaccredited medical colleges must complete two years of approved graduate medical training, meet educational requirements prescribed by the board, and obtain certification by the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) or its successors.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: No license without restriction may be issued to a graduate of an unaccredited medical college unless the applicant has completed successfully, as a resident, two years of approved graduate medical training, educational requirements prescribed by the board and certification by the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates, or its successors.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: No license without restriction may be issued to a graduate of an accredited medical college unless the applicant has completed successfully, as a resident, two years of approved graduate medical training.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant shall provide medical services according to a written agreement which provides for all of the following: (1) Identifies and is signed by the primary supervising physician. (2) Describes the physician assistant's scope of practice. (3) Describes the nature and degree of supervision the primary supervising physician will provide the physician assistant.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A physician assistant shall not independently prescribe or dispense drugs; the board shall promulgate regulations permitting a physician assistant to prescribe and dispense drugs at the direction of a physician.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant shall not independently prescribe or dispense drugs. The board shall promulgate regulations which permit a physician assistant to prescribe and dispense drugs at the direction of a physician.

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: There shall be no more than six physician assistants for whom a physician has responsibility or supervises pursuant to a written agreement at any time.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may defer and ultimately dismiss any of the types of corrective action set forth in this act for an impaired professional so long as the professional is progressing satisfactorily in an approved treatment program

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the board shall, upon probable cause, have authority to compel a practitioner to submit to a mental or physical examination by a physician or a psychologist approved by the board.
